item.title: Double Homicide Under Investigation in Thermal
item.description: The search for a suspect is ongoing this evening after a double homicide in Thermal.According to the Riverside County Sheriff's Department, deputies responded to reports of shots fired around 11 p.m. on Polk Street. item.title: Big Bear Embraces Olympic Spirit with Family Watch Parties
item.description: Olympic excitement is in full swing in Big Bear, where families are gathering for Winter Games watch parties and mountain fun.At the Big Bear Visitor Center and throughout the Moonridge Corridor, visitors are catching live Olympic events while enjoying everything the mountain town has to offer — from snow tubing and mini golf to the popular Alpine Slide and mountain coaster rides.Families visiting for the holiday weekend say it’s the perfect mix of cozy cabin bonding and outdoor adventure. item.title: Modernism Week Kicks Off with Rededication Honoring Nelda Linsk
item.description: Modernism Week officially kicks off today, drawing thousands of architecture and design enthusiasts to Palm Springs for a celebration of midcentury modern style.The popular festival features home and neighborhood tours, art exhibitions, film premieres, and engaging talks and presentations throughout the week.To open the festivities, organizers honored longtime Palm Springs resident Nelda Linsk by rededicating her star on the Palm Springs Walk of the Stars. item.title: Palm Springs International Airport Launches Real-Time Lost & Found Portal
item.description: Palm Springs International Airport is introducing a new online portal designed to help travelers quickly track down lost belongings.In partnership with digital lost-and-found platform Liff Happens, PSP becomes the first airport to adopt the service. item.title: Holocaust Survivor’s Daughter Shares Powerful Family History with Rancho Mirage Students
item.description: Students at Rancho Mirage High School welcomed Michele Gold for a special presentation focused on preserving the personal history of the Holocaust and World War II. item.title: Tastes & Sounds of Cathedral City Boosts Community and Local Businesses
item.description: The Tastes & Sounds of Cathedral City series is officially underway, bringing music lovers and foodies together every Tuesday evening at the Cathedral City Community Amphitheater.The seasonal event pairs local artists with area restaurants, creating a lively atmosphere filled with free live music and a variety of food options. item.title: DAP Health Stonewall Medical Center Steps Up as Platinum Sponsor for Cathedral City Pride
item.description: DAP Health and its Stonewall Medical Center are deepening their presence in the Coachella Valley’s LGBTQ+ community by becoming a platinum sponsor of Cathedral City’s signature Pride celebration. item.title: New Federal Judicial Ethics Guidance Says Judges May Respond to ‘Illegitimate’ Attacks
item.description: Newly released ethics guidance for the federal judiciary clarifies that judges may publicly respond to what it calls “illegitimate forms of criticism and attacks,” while still emphasizing the need for restraint to maintain public trust in the courts.The updated guidance affirms that judges can take part in civic engagement, including speaking and writing about core issues such as the rule of law and judicial independence.
